description:
Searches the Brazilian Federal Senate open data (senators in office and active committees of the Senate and the National Congress) catalog and returns up to 10 matching documents as { id, title, url }, ordered by relevance (an empty list means nothing matched).

This tool exists for the OpenAI Deep Research contract: ChatGPT deep research, company knowledge and research workflows over the Responses API require exactly the tools `search` and `fetch`. Pass one of the returned ids to `fetch` to read the document.
For direct questions and for data (values, series, rankings) prefer the `senado_*` tools, which return the actual data with provenance — this is a catalog index, not a data query.

Query: natural language or keywords, Portuguese or English; accents and case are ignored.

Behavior: read-only and idempotent — the catalog comes from the public source and is cached in memory.

query.description: Termos de busca em linguagem natural ou palavras-chave (acentos e caixa são ignorados)

name: search

attribution.description: URLs de origem dos dados (as source_url distintas dos blocos de proveniência, incluindo as de field_sources), para linkar a citação

provenance.description: Bloco de proveniência do portfólio (projeção concise): source, source_url, data_vintage, retrieved_at (horário de Brasília), citation, license, revision e retrieval; field_sources só quando a resposta funde recortes, derived e derivation_note só nos modos de estatísticas. retrieval é o diagnóstico da ida à origem nesta chamada — requisições, tentativas com retentativas, anomalias superadas (timeout, network, rate_limited, http_5xx, http_4xx, malformed_body) e unstable (true quando algo precisou ser repetido) —, ou null quando não foi medido. Lista de blocos quando a chamada consulta várias fontes (índice do search).

title: Busca para Deep Research
